'''Engineering Team Gamma''' was a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Engineer/Legends|engineering]] team that was stationed on [[Taris/Legends|Taris]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. [[Ferron]], [[Imani]], and [[Bailey]] were members of the unit, and they were tasked with restoring power to a number of generators in the [[Tularan Marsh]].
